programme.title: Easy Heart

programme.title: Secret Millionaire

programme.title: What I Did for Love
programme.desc: After a lawyer (Jeremy London) proposes to his girlfriend (Dorie Barton), they head to her family's ranch for the holidays, where he must gain approval from her difficult dad (James Gammon) and cope with her scheming aunt (Sally Struthers), who informs her niece's ex-flame of the blossoming relationship. Mark Griffiths directed.

programme.desc: A woman returns home to Texas after an eight-year absence to claim the ranch her grandfather left to her in his will. Unfortunately, she has to somehow bridge the generation gap when she finds herself at loggerheads with her father.

programme.title: Can't Buy My Love
programme.desc: Lilly, an EMT and aspiring medical student falls for Jeff, a rich, aimless guy.

programme.title: Operation Cupcake
programme.desc: A colonel returns to his family during a two-month military leave but finds it difficult to fit in with his wife and kids, who've gotten used to not having him around. In an attempt to close the distance, the man begins working at his wife's bakery, but his military management style ends up doing more harm than good.

programme.title: The Cabin
programme.desc: A divorced mom (Lea Thompson) and her kids are forced to bunk with a single dad (Steven Brand) and his two children after a cabin mix-up at a resort in Scotland. Though the adults initially clash, they decide to join forces to compete in a sporting event at the resort, and it's not long before sparks start to fly. Directed by Brian Trenchard-Smith.

programme.title: Mr. Fiction
programme.desc: Emma, a young bookshop owner and hopeless romantic, has to make some tough life choices when the man of her dreams walks into her store.

programme.title: Brimming With Love
programme.desc: A skeptical journalist writing a column on a matchmaking coffee shop owner agrees to be matched, but she proves to be a challenge. The reason may be that she is perfect for the matchmaker.

programme.title: My George
programme.desc: A struggling writer pens a romance novel, and then she searches for an ideal boyfriend like the one in her book to help her agent with publicity. Before long, she meets a charming real-estate agent and reconnects with an old high-school friend.

Though the adults initially clash, they decide to join forces to compete in a sporting event at the resort, and it's not long before sparks start to fly. Directed by Brian Trenchard-Smith.

programme.title: Mr. Fiction
programme.desc: Emma, a young bookshop owner and hopeless romantic, has to make some tough life choices when the man of her dreams walks into her store.

programme.title: Brimming With Love
programme.desc: A skeptical journalist writing a column on a matchmaking coffee shop owner agrees to be matched, but she proves to be a challenge. The reason may be that she is perfect for the matchmaker.

programme.title: My George
programme.desc: A struggling writer pens a romance novel, and then she searches for an ideal boyfriend like the one in her book to help her agent with publicity. Before long, she meets a charming real-estate agent and reconnects with an old high-school friend.

programme.title: Romantically Speaking
programme.desc: A relationship expert's public love life goes on the rocks, so her best male friend steps in to help keep up appearances, and their relationship takes an interesting turn.

programme.title: Horton Foote's 'Alone'
programme.desc: An elderly farmer (Hume Cronyn) who's contemplating retirement is pressured by his relatives to sell his property. Grey: James Earl Jones. Gus Jr.: Chris Cooper. Agnes: Hallie Foote. Jackie: Joanna Miles. Paul: David Selby. Estelle: Shelley Duvall. Carl: Frederic Forrest. Grace Ann: Roxanne Hart. Michael Lindsay-Hogg directed.

programme.title: Letter Never Sent
programme.desc: Henry discovers a love letter he wrote in high school to his best friend and attempts to share it to see if she feels the same way, but it ends up in her new boyfriends possession.

programme.title: Expecting a Miracle
programme.desc: Botched directions lead a struggling couple (Teri Polo, Jason Priestley) to a small Mexican town whose residents have a positive effect on the pair's faltering marriage. Cheech Marin and Rebeka Montoya also star. Directed by Steve Gomer.

programme.title: The Shell Seekers
programme.desc: Angela Lansbury is a widow searching for a meaning to her life in this teleplay adapted from Rosamunde Pilcher's novel. Olivia: Patricia Hodge. Nancy: Anna Carteret. Noel: Christopher Bowen. Antonia: Sophie Ward. Richard: Sam Wanamaker. Danus: Mark Lewis Jones. Cosmo: Denis Quilley. Dolly: Irene Worth. Roy: Michael Gough. George: John Rowe. Filmed in England and Spain.

programme.title: Woman of the House
programme.desc: A woman who feels nostalgic about her college sorority days takes a job as a house mother to her former chapter. Along with bringing out the best in the girls, she helps to turn the chapter around with the help of the charming Dean of Student Affairs.

programme.title: Love's Abiding Joy
programme.desc: In this drama based on the fourth book in Janette Oke's best-selling "Love Comes Softly" series, Missie and Willie LaHaye (Erin Cottrell, Logan Bartholomew) get accustomed to rugged frontier life, but tragedy threatens to shake up their stable family. Michael Landon Jr. directed.

programme.title: Bad Date Chronicles
programme.desc: Leigh runs the popular website 'Bad Date Chronicles' where daters can go to anonymously post horrible date experiences. When rival blogger Conner becomes the subject of one of her posts, they agree to date each other in order to prove which one is actually a bad dater.

programme.title: Fixing Pete
programme.desc: A fashion columnist (Brooke Burns) receives an assignment to make over a sloppy sportswriter (Dylan Bruno). As the pair spend time together, they learn from each other and sparks begin to fly. But romantic complications threaten to keep them apart. Directed by Michael Grossman.

programme.title: A Stranger's Heart
programme.desc: Samantha Mathis plays Callie, the recipient of a long-awaited heart transplant whose cynical attitude dissipates as she longs for a connection with her donor's orphaned daughter. Looking for something "new", he comes across a show called Videodrome while pirating signals from satellite dishes. The show appears to depict actual tortures and murder. When Renn tries to find its origin, he becomes involved in a bizarre and confusing fusion of television, politics and mind control that seems to herald a "New Order" for society.

programme.desc: Satirical fantasy comedy starring Margot Robbie and Ryan Gosling. A group of scientists and mercenaries are sent to a newly discovered Pacific island to investigate its unusual fauna. When their convoy is destroyed, the team faces a battle for survival against Skull Island's monstrous inhabitants - among them a certain giant ape.

programme.desc: Action adventure starring Harrison Ford and Karen Allen. Indiana Jones's outrageous exploits take him around the world in search of the legendary Ark of the Covenant, a religious artefact of unspeakable power wanted by the Nazis. With the help of an old flame, Indy takes on his enemies in a terrifying and death-defying battle to the finish.

On the trail of fortune and glory in Shanghai, Indy is launched on a dangerous new quest that takes him to India via the Himalayas. With his faithful companion Short Round and nightclub singer Willie Scott, Indy goes in search of the magical Sankara stone and uncovers an ancient evil that threatens all who come into contact with it.

In a desperate race against time, Indy encounters some old enemies and once again finds himself in pursuit of an ancient religious artefact.

However, this is only the start of a series of adventures that will take Indy deep into the Amazon jungle in search of a mysterious crystal skull.
